Your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in #inc-vtg-hartford. You wrote that the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.

In the meantime, the guard was checking trucks in by hand, writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07.

I posted this as a threaded reply to your question in the channel.
